title: The Placement–Runtime Divide
missionBriefing: Two Pods are unhealthy for different reasons: one has never been assigned; the other was assigned but cannot start its container. Diagnose each boundary and make both Pods Running without changing their names.
successCriteria: Both original Pod names are preserved.
hints: First ask whether .spec.nodeName is populated, then inspect events.
Remove the impossible nodeSelector from placement-case; repair the runtime-case image.
